_description: Golden reference for dtoo_export.py characterization tests. Generated locally; checksum must be updated inside the dtOO container.

DTOO_CASE_DIR.behavior_unset: Uses default path; script chdir's there at start of main()
DTOO_CASE_DIR.behavior_set_valid: chdir to the provided directory; must contain machine.xml + machineSave.xml + xml/
DTOO_CASE_DIR.behavior_set_nonexistent: Raises FileNotFoundError (or OSError) on os.chdir() — frozen error type
DTOO_CASE_DIR.notes: This is the dtOO case directory baked into the container image at /dtOO/test/tistos

DTOO_MACHINE_XML.behavior_set: Passed to dtXmlParser.init() as the machine XML filename

DTOO_STATE_XML.behavior_set: Passed to dtXmlParser.init() as the state XML filename

DTOO_STATE.behavior_set: Loads the named state from machineSave.xml via parser.loadStateToConst()
DTOO_STATE.notes: State name must exist in the state XML

DTOO_MECH_VOLUME.notes: Must be a valid bounded volume label in the dtOO case

DTOO_ADJUST_PLUGIN.behavior_unset: Attempts to apply the default domain-adjust plugin
DTOO_ADJUST_PLUGIN.behavior_set: Attempts to apply the named plugin; if missing, prints warning and continues
DTOO_ADJUST_PLUGIN.notes: Plugin is optional — caught with a broad except that logs and continues

DTOO_DESIGN_JSON.behavior_unset: Empty string → no design overrides → baseline geometry
DTOO_DESIGN_JSON.behavior_set_valid: Loads {label: value} dict and applies cV.get(label).setValue(value) before geometry creation
DTOO_DESIGN_JSON.behavior_set_invalid: File does not exist → falls back to baseline geometry with a console message
DTOO_DESIGN_JSON.notes: Path can be absolute or relative; empty/missing builds the template geometry

DTOO_OUTPUT_MSH.behavior_unset: Writes to data/runner.msh relative to dtoo_export.py location
DTOO_OUTPUT_MSH.behavior_set: Writes to the specified path; parent directories are created with os.makedirs(exist_ok=True)
DTOO_OUTPUT_MSH.notes: This is the mesh file consumed by the FEniCSx stage (main.py / evaluate.py)

DTOO_LOG_FILE.behavior_unset: Derives log path from DTOO_OUTPUT_MSH directory
DTOO_LOG_FILE.behavior_set: Explicit log file path passed to logMe.initLog()
DTOO_LOG_FILE.notes: Initialized inside main() after dtOOPythonSWIG import
